new_negatives.failure: An unquoted PowerShell revision expression transformed HEAD...@{u} before Git received it.
new_negatives.recovery: Pass the complete revision expression as one explicitly quoted argument and require the observed divergence to be zero and zero.

new_negatives.failure: A mixed rg file enumeration included an owner path that did not yet exist and returned nonzero after emitting useful rows.
new_negatives.recovery: Resolve each optional path first, enumerate only existing roots, and treat verified absence as an attributable zero-row result.

new_negatives.failure: A read-only rg manifest-discovery command passed a Windows wildcard path literally and returned an invalid-path error after partial useful output.
new_negatives.recovery: Resolve wildcard candidates with an explicit path array, then pass concrete existing filenames to rg.

new_negatives.failure: The first x1 manifest builder computed an unstored hash-object identifier and then asked git cat-file to read the absent object.
new_negatives.recovery: Use git hash-object -w with the repository path filter, then read the stored blob once for byte count and SHA-256.

new_negatives.failure: The recovered x1 manifest was built before the final overview write and exact staged replay found one overview blob mismatch.
new_negatives.recovery: Write every non-self-excluded x1 artifact first, then build the commit-local manifest as the final generation step.
